description: Out-of-distribution robustness check: COCO (real, label=0) vs DALLE-3 (fake, label=1), clean vs transformed. AUC computed with sklearn.metrics.roc_auc_score on raw 'pred' (P(fake)) scores.

robustness_gap.note: Accuracy is NOT directly comparable between clean and transformed here -- clean is a 4996:1808 (73/27) real:fake split, transformed is 2000:2000 (50/50), so accuracy at a fixed threshold is confounded by class balance. AUC is the valid robustness comparison.
